recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='internal/release/check_test.go'
s=open(p).read().replace('{\"v1.2.3-rc.1\", false},','{\"v1.2.3-rc.1\", false},\\n\\t\\t{\"v1.2.3-rc1\", false},')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w internal/release/check_test.go
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./internal/release -run TestIsExcludesPrereleaseBuilds -count=1"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='internal/release/check.go'
s=open(p).read().replace('if version == \"\" || version == \"dev\" {','if version == \"\" || version == \"dev\" || strings.Contains(version, \"-rc\") {').replace('[]string{\"-dev\", \"-snapshot\", \"-rc\"}','[]string{\"-dev\", \"-snapshot\"}')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w internal/release/check.go
GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./internal/release ./cmd/flipt"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
